A.en: Style: journal-style scientific schematic. Clean flat vector illustration on a white background, light pastel rounded panels to separate regions. Only 3-4 muted colors, each with one fixed meaning; red only for inhibition or emphasis. Thin, uniform line weight. Proteins as rounded colored capsules with their names inside; membranes as lipid bilayers; activation as solid arrows, inhibition as T-bar lines, indirect effects as dashed arrows. Sans-serif English labels only, each label appears exactly once, spelled exactly as given. No 3D rendering, no shadows, no glow, no decorative background, no photorealism.
A.zh: 风格：期刊式科研示意图。白色背景上的干净扁平矢量插画，用浅色圆角面板区分区域。只用 3–4 种低饱和度颜色，每种颜色含义固定，红色只用于抑制或强调。线条细且粗细一致。蛋白画成彩色圆角胶囊，名称写在胶囊里；细胞膜画成磷脂双分子层；激活用实线箭头，抑制用 T 形线，间接作用用虚线箭头。图中文字只用英文无衬线字体，每个标签只出现一次，拼写与给定完全一致。不要 3D 渲染、阴影、发光、装饰性背景或照片质感。

B.en: Style: journal graphical-abstract illustration. Soft semi-realistic medical illustration with gentle volume and subtle hand-painted texture, on a clean white background. Muted, harmonious palette with one accent color. Clear left-to-right narrative, generous white space. Sans-serif English labels only, each label appears exactly once, spelled exactly as given. No cartoon style, no glossy CGI, no dark background, no stock-photo look.
B.zh: 风格：期刊图形摘要插画。柔和的半写实医学插画，带轻微体积感和细腻的手绘质感，白色干净背景。配色低饱和、协调，只用一个强调色。从左到右叙事清晰，留白充足。图中文字只用英文无衬线字体，每个标签只出现一次，拼写与给定完全一致。不要卡通风格、不要光滑的 CG 渲染、不要深色背景、不要图库照片感。

W.en: Style: journal-style experimental workflow figure. Clean flat vector icons on a white background, one light pastel rounded panel per step, thin gray arrows between panels. Only 3-4 muted colors. Each panel shows one simple scene with no text inside it; the only text in the whole figure is the step names given. Sans-serif English, each step name appears exactly once, spelled exactly as given. No legends, no captions, no extra labels, no 3D rendering, no shadows, no decorative background.
W.zh: 风格：期刊式实验流程图。白色背景上干净的扁平矢量图标，每一步一个浅色圆角面板，面板之间用细灰色箭头连接。只用 3–4 种低饱和度颜色。每个面板里只画一个简洁的小场景，面板内不写任何文字；整张图唯一的文字就是给定的步骤名。用英文无衬线字体，每个步骤名只出现一次，拼写与给定完全一致。不要图例、不要说明文字、不要额外标签、不要 3D 渲染、阴影或装饰性背景。
